corpus_scope: Eight authors: displayed 107:1-7 bodies and intros, including duplicate/empty bodies, not whole volumes. Specific supplementary passages and root entries separately logged.
duplicates: Razi107:4 and107:5 repeat the same three-masala commentary (headers differ).
Ibn Masud bucket/pot/axe loans across Tabari, Ibn Kathir, Suyuti, Abu Dawud: one report family.
Ibn Abbas public-prayer/private-omission across authors: one report family.
Suyuti107:3 and Baydawi107:4 display verse only; no commentary coverage invented.
Wahidi named causes and later repetitions are not independent events or historical corroboration.
meaningful_disagreements: Maun: Ibn Umar zakat against Ibn Masud implements, with Tabari broad synthesis.
Sehv: Hasan rejects Abu Aliya ordinary intra-prayer error; valid timing/neglect readings remain.
Makki/Madani and unnamed/general vs named perpetrator differ.
Din reward/account vs Islam/obedience; maun attributions not one uniform tradition.
Maqayis fire/prayer two asls, sehve irregular, Suha possible; analogy cannot erase these.
Maʿin etymology mʿn vs ʿayn and maun maʿuna alternative.
